headline: Approved payments of $19,349, $19,350, $133,295, and $15,451.74 to Leftfield, DesignLab, and Consigli for building work.
summary: The meeting approved payments on building project invoices from Leftfield, DesignLab, and Consigli, as recommended by the Joint Special Building committee. Members also heard that negotiations with the employee union are continuing, with another session scheduled for Monday, 11/2.
decisions: Approved payment of Leftfield invoices #196955 ($19,349) and #199897 ($19,350), unanimously.
Approved payment of DesignLab invoice #26-06.0826 for $133,295, unanimously.
Approved payment of Consigli invoice #1 for $15,451.74, unanimously.

plain_text:
Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees  
October 28, 2026  
6:30 PM  
MINUTES 
A meeting of the Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees was held Wednesday, October 28, 2026, 
scheduled at 6:30 PM at the Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street, Nashua, NH, 03060  
1. Call to Order 
 
 The meeting was called to order at 6:27 PM 
2. Attendance 
 
 In attendance: Linda LaFlamme, Patricia Dresner, Scott Jaquith, Kristin Kane, John Kennedy, 
Ernest Jette.  
Also in attendance was Jennifer McCormack, who took the minutes 
3. Approval of recommendations from Joint Special Building committee 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr Jaquith, seconded by Ms. Kane the board unanimously approved the payment 
of Leftfield invoice #196955 in the amount of $19,349 and invoice # 199897 in the amount of 
$19,350 
 
Upon a motion by Mr Jaquith, seconded by Ms. Kane the board unanimously approved the payment 
of  DesignLab invoice #26-06.0826 in the amount of $133,295 
 
Upon a motion by Mr Jaquith, seconded by Ms. Kane the board unanimously approved the payment 
of Consigli invoice #1 in the amount of $15,451.74 
4. New Business 
 
 Ms. Laflamme informed the board that negotiations with the employee union are continuing, and 
another session is scheduled for Monday, 11/2. 
5. Adjourn 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr. Jette, seconded by Mr. Jaquith the meeting was adjourned at 6:42 PM
